verdict.rationale: Epic's license page promises 'Access to the source code', and community comments confirm source is included, so the code can be read. However, the probe shows the EpicGames/UnrealEngine GitHub repo is gated behind an EULA and account link (it returns Not Found keylessly), and a community comment notes it is not 'free as in freedom', so this is source-available under a proprietary license, not an open one. Missing for 10: an OSI-style open license, keyless/public source access, and first-party docs on the source license terms.
